{{Quote|The PEP laser will stun most humanoids.|[[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]]|<ref name="TZ" />}}
The '''Pulsed energy projectile laser''', commonly shortened to '''PEP laser''', was a non-[[Death/Legends|lethal]] form of weaponry. Originally designed for [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] units tasked with controlling riots, the PEP [[Laser/Legends|laser]] made use of a [[deuterium fluoride]] laser to incapacitate targets without causing serious, long-lasting injury. Effective against most medium-sized [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], the PEP laser emitted a loud shockwave of sound and light when discharged, capable of knocking an individual off of their [[Limb/Legends|feet]] and inflicting pain significant enough that further resistance would be almost physically impossible. Those familiar with the weapon noted that a shot from a PEP laser was similar to being struck with a [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash-bang grenade]] and hit with several [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] rounds in the chest at the same time. Victims of a PEP laser strike were subject to severe bruising at and around the point of impact.<ref name="TZ" /> Despite their unique makeup, PEP laser rounds could be deflected by a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as easily as normal [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts.<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

Noting the usefulness the PEP laser would provide in capturing live [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of interest, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] chose to outfit the elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] with PEP laser attachments for their [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TZ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pulsed energy projectile laser was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel [[Republic Commando: Triple Zero|''Triple Zero'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[February 28]], [[2006]]. The weapon was subsequently mentioned in the novel's sequels, entitled [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']] and [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], before reappearing again in full in the last entry of the series, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''.

The [[:Wikipedia:Pulsed Energy Projectile|Pulsed Energy Projectile]] is a real life non-lethal weapon currently under development by the [[:Wikipedia:United States Armed Forces|United States military]]. While the real device is much larger in its current state, the basic principles behind how the device works within the ''Star Wars'' franchise are essentially the same as its real-world counterpart.
